notes.title: Patch 1 now live!
notes.notes:
In this patch:

FIXED:


    Level 14 and 24 going back to Level 1
    Overlaps in random levels
    Music muting when entering options menu
    Overlaps in level editor
    Custom level loading issues
    Text overlap



IMPROVEMENTS:


    Added restart hotkey: R
    Improved star detection system


Expect in patch 2 fixes for the below issues:


    Long loading times in certain menus
